what: A thin 34px ring follows the cursor, closing .22 of the remaining distance each frame. Over links and buttons it grows to 52px in .25s while its border fades. Over data-cursor cells it becomes a 76px frosted-glass circle showing that text (such as ”Drag”). While pressed it scales to .8, and primary buttons (data-magnet) are pulled toward the cursor by x ±6 and y ±4px

options.pull: Share by which the magnet button is pulled, default .12 (max x 6px · y 4px)
options.targets: Target the ring grows on (css), default a, button, [role=button], input, select, textarea, label, summary, .swiper
options.magnet: Magnet buttons to pull in (css), default [data-magnet]
options.[data-fx-part=label]: Slot for text on the glass circle (child)
options.data-cursor: Over a cell with this attribute, that text is shown (attribute on the target element)

from.where: Cursor ring on every page — original cursor-ring (lerp .22 · 34→52→76px · transition .25s ease · is-down scale .8 · magnet .block-hero__cta etc. ±6/±4 × .12)
